notes.title: UNGATE – Step into the dark. Finish the game. Pass it on.
notes.notes:
[h2][b]A challenge you can’t ignore is waiting for you ![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/fb9ae5e672ca1c68319a2d3dd4e8d2ec77bc6e29.gif"][/img][/p][p]In [i]UNGATE[/i], a narrative first-person survival horror game, you play as [b]Jason[/b], a young man following the trail of his missing friends into a cave that locals in West Village believe to be… the gate to hell.[/p][p]What he finds isn’t just darkness — it’s an entire world haunted by [b]evil creatures, invisible presences,[/b] [b]and[/b] [b]an[/b] [b]atmosphere that tests your every step.[/b][/p][p]🔦 [b]KEY FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]No combat. Only survival.[/b]
You won’t have weapons — only a headlamp and limited supplies. Creatures can be avoided, but never defeated.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Constant tension. Real fear.[/b]
Some creatures are attracted to sound. Others are afraid of light.
One wrong move could be your last.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save your progress.[/b]
The new save system gives you another chance — but it doesn’t guarantee escape.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore. Endure. Finish.[/b]
The underground world holds secrets. Some may help you. Others will destroy you.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]THE UNGATE CHALLENGE:[/b][/p][p]📌 Finish the game.
📌 Survive until the end.
📌 Then... challenge a friend to finish the game. If they dare.[/p][p]🛒 [b]UNGATE[/b] awaits in the dark, starting [b]June 26[/b], with a special discount during the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b].[/p][p]🎮 Add it to your wishlist.
🎁 Take the challenge.
📣 And don’t forget...[b] pass it on.[/b][/p]

notes.title: "Ungate" has been transformed!
notes.notes: [h3][b]"Ungate" has been transformed! The game now features save slots and badges to prove you've fully completed it![/b][/h3][p]I’m very excited to announce one of the most complex updates so far: the implementation of save functionality, along with badges that confirm you've finished the game. [/p][p][b]At the same time, I want to thank those who bought the game at full price to support me; I am deeply grateful ![/b][/p][p]Following the transformation, the following have been implemented/adjusted:[/p][olist][*][p]Saves are available per level, but only on Explorer difficulty. Once a level’s saves are unlocked, you can replay that level without affecting the saves of other levels. However, once you advance to the next level, that level’s save will be overwritten with your current progress (e.g., replay level 1 and then move to level 2 – level 2 will now be saved with your new progress).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/b429145f69f9aa9bb5fb97ed160ef63ae456bcf7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Once the respawn option is unlocked, Explorer difficulty also benefits from unlimited lives.[/p][/*][*][p]When loading a saved game, you will always start from a respawn point based on your last known position (Level 1 has 4 respawn points, while Levels 2 and 3 each have one).[/p][/*][*][p]On Survivor difficulty, there are no saves, and you must finish the game in a single attempt—but you'll have 3 lives per level once the respawn option is unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Surface respawn points now have different colors depending on the area:[/p][list][*][p][b]Black color[/b]– the area that includes the cabin[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/c26546bc8bad14adfd74aef0d5bbcb07ad8a7fc7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Green color[/b] (The fountain of Life) – the area that includes the military base in the forest[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/45db41faef2f742253081c2d0b0c6d6d4075e309.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]White color[/b] (The fountain of Life) – the area that includes the swamp house[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/ebf54db3d3a47dea488f9a158eefe1cd162cf40f.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Red color[/b] (The fountain of Life) – the area that includes the dark temple[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/0a0780c8a8177ca21d12db239157cc3c9872d11f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Badges[/b] can only be unlocked by completing the game on each specific difficulty.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669554/5f32f94d6d0fd1d1fbbd5db1288a95cc87adbb4a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][p]In addition to the main implementations, sounds and player interactions have been adjusted, and the game has been re-optimized for better performance, especially on Level 1 (surface).[/p][p][b]Optional[/b]: If for any reason you want to delete the saves directly from the game files, you can find them here: [b]C:\\Users\\\[YourUsername]\\AppData\\Local\\Ungate\\Saved\\SaveGames[/b][/p][p]Here you’ll find the save files divided as:[/p][list][*][p][b]Badges.sav[/b] – can be deleted individually[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level_1.sav[/b] – can be deleted individually[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level_2.sav[/b] – can be deleted individually[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level_3.sav[/b] – can be deleted individually[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings.sav[/b] – it is not recommended to delete this file unless you're also deleting all 3 level saves[/p][/*][/list][p][b]I hope you enjoy all these implementations and have a smooth experience throughout the game. Thank you for your patience, and don’t forget to challenge your friends to finish the game ![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Have a great day, everyone ![/b][/p]

notes.title: The application withdrawal has been canceled
notes.notes:
[b]I want to be very honest with you, and I kindly ask for your patience in reading this text:[/b]

[b]First of all, I would like to thank all the Steam users who purchased the game to support me. This proves that Steam has a strong and responsive community. I am truly grateful for what you have done for me, and this will stay with me forever.[/b]

I would also like to clarify that the game is fully completed and apologize for any confusion caused by my previous wording, which might have given the impression that the project was unfinished.

In my previous announcement, what I was actually referring to—without being explicit—was that the company I created to publish the game requires maintenance with annual expenses that are quite high (at least for me, as I am working alone). I also started the company with the goal of continuing to create games, with this first game serving as a way to finance my next project (which, at this stage, is only in the idea/sketch phase and is planned as an adventure game). But, if the company cannot survive without me constantly having to fund it out of pocket, then the most rational decision would be to shut it down, as I simply cannot afford this luxury since my additional funds are now exhausted. As a result of shutting down the company, the game will have to be withdrawn.

At this moment, thanks to your support, I will be able to cover about 70% of the company's expenses, which led me to the decision to cancel the game's withdrawal for another year as a response to your initiative.

I also want to emphasize that all previous updates were made with great pleasure based on players’ constructive feedback. To me, a completed game is one that takes user feedback into account, implementing suggestions to improve the experience and make it more enjoyable. I know I am a beginner, and for that reason, I am willing to continue improving the project I created.

Moving forward, considering the latest player suggestions and the support you have given me, I will work on creating a series of updates that will transform the game. At the same time, I kindly ask for your patience in implementing them, as this is the first game I have ever developed, without having any prior background in gaming or technology. Everything I have learned has been through online tutorials and a lot of determination.


[b]Upcoming Updates:[/b]
1. I will implement a save option for Explorer difficulty at all three levels, in the initial respawn areas of each level. This will allow players to complete the game without having to start from the beginning every time they exit, enabling them to continue their challenge from the initial respawn point of their current level.

2. On Survivor difficulty, players will not be able to access saves made on Explorer difficulty. To complete the game on this difficulty, players will need to finish it in a single attempt — this being the final challenge of the game.

3. I will add two badges to reflect the completion of the game on both difficulty levels: one for finishing on Explorer (which includes saves) and another for completing Survivor mode in a single run. These two earned badges will be permanently visible in the game's start menu.

4. Once both badges are obtained, you will be able to prove that you have beaten the game in its entirety !

[b]Thank you again for your amazing support ![/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]The game now offers 2 difficulty options to choose from: Survivor and Explorer, as well as 2 language options: English and Romanian. Additionally, a Brightness option has been added, along with several upgrades to the UX/UI interface;[/b]

[b]Once again, the game should be treated as a challenge, therefore I challenge you to finish the game; next, you should challenge your friends to finish the game and so on ![/b]

Here are the rules for each difficulty: 

[b]EXPLORER DIFFICULTY RULES:[/b] 

1. There's no savegame, once you exit the game you will start from the beginning
2. After finishing the cabin's objectives you'll unlock 1 respawn zone with unlimited lives and the progress will be kept
3. If you die before unlocking your unlimited lives you'll start from the beginning
4. The game has 3 levels and if you get to a respawn zone and unlock it, you'll respawn at that location
5. If you die, you will respawn at the last unlocked respawn zone you walked on
6. Using crouch can make you silent and also recover your stamina faster
7. You can use your journal to check the gathered clues
8. The game becomes really intense along the way and also the difficulty increases
9. Only bravery, vigilence, curiosity and attention to details will get you to the end

[b]SURVIVOR DIFFICULTY RULES:[/b] 

1. There's no savegame, once you exit the game or die 3 times after you unlock your 3 lives, you will start from the beginning
2. If you die before unlocking your 3 lives you'll start from the beginning
3. The game has 3 levels and if you get to a respawn zone and activate it, you'll unlock your 3 lives per level
4. If you die, you will respawn at the last activated respawn zone you walked on, up to 3 times and the progress will be kept
5. Using crouch can make you silent and also recover your stamina faster
6. You can use your journal to check the gathered clues
7. The game becomes really intense along the way and also the difficulty increases
8. Only bravery, vigilence, curiosity and attention to details will get you to the end

notes.title: Price adjustment & updates for "Ungate" !
notes.notes:
I. Price adjustment for "Ungate" !

Hello everyone,

Hope you're doing well and ready for some thrilling updates !

As promised, I've made an adjustment to the game's price, bringing it down from 25$ to an even more accesible 10$. This decision was made to better align with the challenging experience that 'Ungate' offers and to ensure that everyone can dive into the adventure without breaking the bank. xD

This price adjustment is a step towards making 'Ungate' accesible to a broader audience. Your feedback and support have been really valuable for me, and I want to make sure that as many players as possible get to experience the unique world I've created.

Feel free to share the news with your gaming friends, and let them know that the journey through 'Ungate' is now even more affordable. I believe this adjustment will open up the opportunity for more players to join the challenge and share their experience.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and let's continue this epic journey together.

Happy gaming !



II. At the same time, the translation of the game into the following languages: German, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French and Romanian, is in progress.

the first language in which the game will be translated is romanian as it is easier for me to create a system that can switch the languages using my native one.

translations will take some time and there is a lot of work to do. For now, the game will be available in English, but you can join the game's Reddit page to stay up to date with announcements, or you can check the game's website and social media for updates, as I will be posting about the progress.

PS: You can expect an average of 6+ hours of gameplay in order to learn how to play the game.

Thank you !

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have an important announcement to make!

Given that the game is designed to provide a challenging experience, I will be working on adjusting its price to better align with its intended purpose. In January 2024, the game's price will be revised for increased accessibility, allowing you to enjoy it at a lower cost. For those who have already purchased the game, I genuinely appreciate your support and trust in my work. Please don't be upset with me for this decision, as your contributions mean a lot to me and are instrumental in creating the next project :)

At the same time, I would like to announce that I will be translating the game into the following languages: German, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, and Romanian. These translations will take some time as there will be a lot of work to do. For now, it will remain available in English, but you can join the game's Reddit page to stay up to date with announcements, or you can check the game's website and social media for updates, as I will be posting about the progress.

PS: You can expect an average of 6+ hours of gameplay in order to learn how to play the game.

Thank you & I hope you’ll enjoy the experience :)
